0:
Jasmine has joined us. We have
set out for the Lake of Tears.
1:
Father,
they say that lake was once a
beautiful city called D'Or.

The witch Thaegan's magic
turned it into a lonely lake.
2:
Yes… But I will go.
As long as a gem taken from the
Belt of Deltora lies there.
3: Let's rest here for a bit.
9: Enemies are coming! Can't you hear the trees stirring?
11: Grey Guards, and lots of them.
16: (A Ralad.) (A tribe of builders treasured by Deltora's royal house.) (The Ralads built the palace in Del.)
21: (Say what you like. Our mission is…)
31: There's no end to them, run!
33: I wonder what happened to that Ralad.
34: I'm curious too… But we did what we could.
36: Shall we go back and look?
37: No! The Grey Guards may have told the Shadow Lord by now. And the witch Thaegan rules this area.
40: That's one witch I don't want finding me.
44: Stay back! It's a bottomless bog!
53: Sorry… If I'd been more careful…
54: Did the people of this house save us?
58: No idea… I've never heard that language. But it seems they've prepared this for us.
60: (I have a bad feeling about this.)
62: You saved us, and now such a feast… Thank you so much.
67: Don't make fun of instincts sharpened by life in the forest.
68: Lief, have you noticed anything odd?
71: It's fine. The Belt's here, and the topaz is safe…
75:
The topaz strengthens its wearer's mind
and guards against darkness.
It shows the truth to the mind's eye.
76: What we've been seeing is an illusion! The topaz has shown me the truth! Jasmine, your instincts were right!
78: This isn't a cosy room at all. It's a horrible monster's lair.
81: Wait! The power of the topaz!
82: What are we supposed to do!
84:
Stepping Stones

Touch a nearby stone to jump.
"Leap toward the truth."
86: And I thought we'd finally get some fresh meat.
87: It's not too late. Let's catch them and eat them!
89: That's the true form of those two kind people! They were going to eat us!
94: Leave them to me! Barda, get Jasmine!
96: We were so close to eating meat!
98: Argh, this bog mud is so heavy.
101: Thank you. You saved us. What's your name?
103:
I never knew.
The witch Thaegan stole the
voices of the Ralads.
104:
But the Ralad wrote in the dirt
to tell us. His name is Manus.
105:
For five long years Manus was a slave
to Jin and Jod, the servants of
the witch Thaegan.

He had only just escaped
when the Grey Guards caught him…
106:
So he thanked us for saving him,
almost too much.

Then he invited us to
Raladin, home of the Ralads.
109: Look… at the door of that house.
110: The mark of the Shadow Lord.
111: It seems the Shadow Lord destroyed this place.
115: Look! Lots of Ralads are coming out!
116: That's it!! Ha ha ha! The Ralads were hiding underground. Those builders are as good as they say! They must have built a fine city down there.
117:
As the saviours of Manus, we were
given a wonderful welcome.

There was a city underground,
just as Barda guessed.

We ate well and slept soundly at last.
118:
It was so comfortable, we stayed
in Raladin for several days.

We might have stayed longer if
Barda hadn't lost his temper.
Father, you were right to send him with me.
119: Well, Manus. You can go home now.
120: Your life is ours, you say?
121: Thank you. But you've done enough.
126: Our attacks won't work on that thing!
127: But we have no choice but to fight!
131: This is a fine sword. I'll keep it.
132: No! That was from my father!
134: Give it up for now, Lief.
135: What on earth shall we do…
136: The gem is close. The Belt's growing warm.
140: (What a cheerful tune…) (I had fun in Del…) (I thought I hated that city, but it was better than now…)
143: At the end of this journey, a world as happy as this tune…
144: Yes, I hope we can make a happy world.
146: (You're right.) (I mustn't think the past was better.) (This journey is about opening up the future.)
148: Why have you come to this forbidden place?
151: We came looking for a certain gem.
152: I see. Then I have it. Now, what shall I do?
153: What do you want in return for the gem? Name it! I'll find you anything.
154: Gyee hee hee hee! I will give you the gem. In return, give me the one who plays the flute.
156: Manus, is it? As long as you live… you shall play that flute without rest, to soothe my heart.
159: See how he wishes to come to me!
160: Don't be ridiculous! We won't give him up!
161: Give me that man! Or I shall kill every one of you!
164: You would… give your lives… for Manus. And Manus… would give his life for you. Long ago… so long ago… I too…
165: Something… is happening… to me… My heart… is being cleansed…
166: (That's it! His heart is responding to the topaz!)
168: (The Belt is hot.) (So this is the gem we seek.) (But was there ever a pink gem?)
169: What is it? Are you not satisfied?
171: (Think calmly.) (Yes, remember the book, The Belt of Deltora.)
172:
The great ruby is a symbol of happiness.

But when evil draws near,
its red fades.
173: (If red fades, it turns pink!) (So the ruby senses the presence of evil!)
176:
As we hid behind the rocks,
the witch appeared.
178:
Thaegan looked around with
eyes full of hate, and then vanished.
179:
Thaegan was searching for us.

I'm sure that one day she will
find us… and try to take our lives.
180:
Father, Mother.
We now have two gems.
Five remain.

Please pray for us…
and for the future of Deltora.
181:
A table loaded with food.
The smell is irresistible.
182: I've been wondering… What is this?
184: You can use that for Item Mixing! I can make items from materials at my house!
185: You can make things with this…?
187: All right, all right. If anyone can, it's Jasmine.
